title: BONDERITE® S-ST 6813E AERO – 55 GAL
description: Improved stripping. Thixotropic, alkaline liquid used to remove polyurethanes, epoxies, epoxy primers, etc. from all aircraft alloys, including aluminum, mild steel, titanium, high-strength steel, magnesium and many composites. Applied by spray, flow-on or brush techniques. No chlorinated solvents. MIL-R-25134.
